why: B is false (not_B): it allows n = 1, where clause (d) claims ∫₀¹ sin²(πt)((n−1)π² − L²K(Pₙ,Pₙ)) < 0 and E**(W_i,W_i) < 0 for some i ≠ n; for n = 1 the integrand vanishes and Fin 1 has no i ≠ n. Counter-model: S¹ ⊆ ℝ² through the Bridge, the great circle of speed L = 4 > π (r = 1), P₁ = γ'/L (blind parallel unit field, vel = L·P₁), Ricci tensor of S¹ = 0 (Emb.ricci_eq + Morse.ricci_sph), so (d)'s hypothesis holds and it asks for an i ≠ n in Fin 1. Hence ¬(A → B) and B ⇒ A only ex falso. Corrected reading (n ≥ 2): A gives E**(sin(πt)P, sin(πt)P) = 2∫(π²cos² − sin²⟨R(V,P)V,P⟩) for a parallel unit P along a smooth ℝ-extension c (energyHessian_sin_parallel; formula-defined energyHessian, cos² form) and, for dim ≥ 2, SOME X ∈ TΩ with E**(X,X) < 0 (exists_energyHessian_neg; X not said to be a W_i); Bcorr has W_i ∈ TΩ, the −∫⟨W, D²W/dt² + R(V,W)V⟩ form for the variation-defined E** (IsHessT), the Ricci sum formula, negativity, and 'E**(W_i,W_i) < 0 for some i ≠ n'. These are believed to follow on ↥N from A plus glue (not attempted, see embedded note).
